design: ADR-025 option B working design; acceptance still provisional

sources.owner_intent_scope: Journal.create owner API attests intent/internal and exact --allow-file/internal; labels materialized only here
sources.utf8_file: explicit exact whole-file label, scope, inventory, physical alias checks before read
sources.memory_provenance: Memory.add owner API explicit label and whole-record receipt; search verifies project/expiry/inventory/digest
sources.persona: Identity.save owner API internal receipt; old versions require ID review
sources.tool_output: registered operation, admitted scope, verifier, inherited maximum classification; no authority
sources.model_steps_revisions: schema validation, admitted task lineage, registry, immutable revisions; no authority
sources.saved_legacy_result: no migration attestation; manual ID/digest review, existing permissions immutable

sinks.ollama: numeric loopback only; admitted task/persona/results before call; private local grant
sinks.worker: before IPC persistence/Popen and repeated in worker; minimal environment
sinks.journal: before writes; digest-bound derivation refresh is transactional
sinks.diagnostics: closed errors; no unreviewed/private payload; event lifecycle metadata only
sinks.preview: owner request, admitted exact task, explicit private preview sink, existing ACL/TTL

private_local.grant: exact files and project memory classes; diagnostics excluded

inventory.review: ID, expiry, label; never effect approval

residuals: same-account process and database are trusted
no control of arbitrary external Git clients
absent connector tests do not certify real integrations

admission_lifecycle.canonical_retention: independent of projection authorization; no automatic deletion or renewal
admission_lifecycle.renewal: owner-only ID/project/unchanged current and previous digest/classification/explicit later expiry; inventory and scope rechecked
admission_lifecycle.reconciliation: owner project/current digest, active admission; atomic evidence/event/receipt; expiry and effect approvals unchanged
admission_lifecycle.index: single project/ID entry synchronized transactionally on mark/review/renewal; rebuild uses same eligibility
admission_lifecycle.history: payload-free bounded show-audit after expiry/revocation; append-only prior and new receipt metadata
